subject: english-language-arts
title: Grade 3 English Language Arts
description: A third-grade literacy course built for the year learners move from learning to read toward reading to learn. Foundational decoding and fluency are taught every day beside literary and informational reading, sentence and paragraph development, grammar, vocabulary, small-scale research, and speaking and listening with private and no-audio alternatives. All practice texts are original Manuel Academy passages or clearly identified public-domain works.
capstone: A year-end literacy portfolio containing an original narrative, an explanatory piece, an opinion piece, a research card, and a growth reflection, presented publicly, privately, in print, or in another accessible form.

subject: english-language-arts
title: Grade 4 English Language Arts
description: A fourth-grade literacy course organized around evidence. Learners summarize, determine theme, analyze how informational texts are structured, weigh the reasons and evidence an author supplies, integrate two sources, and write multi-paragraph explanatory, opinion, and narrative pieces for a stated audience. A leaner but real foundational thread keeps morphology-driven decoding and fluency in daily practice. All practice texts are original Manuel Academy passages or clearly identified public-domain works.
capstone: A year-end literacy portfolio containing an original narrative, an explanatory piece, an opinion piece, a research brief with a source list, a two-text comparison, and a growth reflection, presented publicly, privately, in print, or in another accessible form.
